intro: Slip into comfort with Scout. Its push-back recline moves as you lean, soft foam cushions hold you gently, and the high backrest supports you fully, turning daily pauses into restful escapes at home.

features.title: Effortless push-back reclining
features.text: No levers or buttons—just lean back. The backrest and footrest move together, letting you find your perfect angle for watching, reading, or napping.

features.title: High backrest for total support
features.text: A tall backrest with head support engulfs your body, relaxing the spine and neck so you unwind without strain after long workdays.

features.title: Cushioned comfort you sink into
features.text: Slab stock foam in the seat, back, and armrests delivers softness with balanced support, giving you a floating, weightless feeling.

features.title: Sleek armrests for ergonomic ease
features.text: Rounded armrests let your arms rest naturally, helping you settle into a posture that feels both comfortable and secure.

features.title: Smooth and noiseless mechanism
features.text: Powder-coated steel linkages create a silent, stable recline tested for up to 110 kg, ensuring durability with every use.

features.title: Easy-care synthetic leather
features.text: The black synthetic leather finish looks refined and needs low maintenance, keeping your recliner stylish without extra effort.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Scout Manual 1-Seater Synthetic Leather Recliner
